biggest_catch: Wyzant takes 25% off the top and pays semi-monthly - expect the first payout up to 2 weeks after your first lesson.
catches: Semi-monthly payouts only - money can be up to ~2 weeks out.
Lessons older than 14 days cannot be submitted for payment.
A lesson must be submitted 5+ business days before the 1st/15th disbursement to make that payout.

c1.evidence: wyzant.com/howitworks/tutors: 'Choose your own hourly rate.'; official tutor job posts: 'most tutors charge between $30-60/hour'.

c2.evidence: support.wyzant.com: 'Semi-monthly direct deposits are made on the 1st and 15th of the month.'

c3.evidence: No upfront fee documented in official terms.

c4.evidence: Numeric rate band ($30-$60/hr typical), 25% platform fee, 1st/15th disbursements - all from official Wyzant pages.

eligibility: 18+, US resident, valid Social Security Number; no teaching certification required.
notes: Official: wyzant.com/howitworks/tutors (choose own rate, direct deposit) and support.wyzant.com 'When will I be paid?' (1st/15th disbursements, 5-business-day and 14-day submission rules).
payout_quote: Tutors choose their own hourly rate (official tutor job posts: most tutors charge $30-$60/hr). Per official support article: 'All tutors will retain 75% of their posted hourly rate for lessons with students, minus any applicable taxes, and Wyzant will retain a 25% Platform Fee.'
steps: Complete the tutor application at wyzant.com (response within 24-48 hours).
Create your profile and set your hourly rate.
Students book you; report your time after each completed lesson.
Wyzant collects payment, deducts the 25% fee, and direct-deposits your share on the 1st and 15th.
timing: Official support article: 'Semi-monthly direct deposits are made on the 1st and 15th of the month.' A lesson must be submitted at least 5 business days before the disbursement date; lessons older than 14 days cannot be submitted.

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per booked lesson; no bookings, no pay

maximize: Refer students yourself and keep 100% of your rate on their lessons (no platform fee) - that's the highest-margin loop on Wyzant. Submit lessons the same day so you beat the 5-business-day cutoff for the next 1st/15th payout, and never let a lesson go unreported past 14 days or the money is gone forever.
payout_value_note: 75% of typical $30-$60/hr rate after official 25% platform fee; per lesson hour
numeric_basis: backfill: payout: 75% of $30-$60/hr typical official; time: 60min per one-hour lesson
who_pays: Students pay through Wyzant. Wyzant collects the payment, keeps a 25% platform fee, and pays you the remaining 75% of your posted hourly rate.
who_qualifies: 18 or older, US resident, valid Social Security Number. No teaching certification required.
what_gets_accepted: Only completed lessons you report to Wyzant count. You must submit each lesson's time; lessons older than 14 days cannot be submitted for payment.
costs_and_unpaid_time: 25% platform fee on every lesson; no upfront fee. Semi-monthly payouts mean cash can sit up to ~2 weeks; a lesson must be submitted at least 5 business days before the 1st/15th disbursement to make that payout. Unpaid: the application process and any lesson prep.
when_cash_arrives: Semi-monthly direct deposits on the 1st and 15th of the month. Expect the first payout up to 2 weeks after your first lesson.
